changelog:
This one installs normally — no uninstall needed.

WHAT'S NEW
Get started without leaving the TV. No account yet? Create one on the sign-in screen, start a free 2-day trial with no card, or buy a plan — and the Player signs you in the moment it is ready.
My Account. See what you have, how long is left on it, extend it, redeem a gift code, or switch the Player to a different service.
Plex signs in by itself. Signed into Live TV in the Player? Plex connects on its own — no more codes to send to your provider.
Your login, emailed to you. After a trial or a purchase your username and password are sent to your inbox, so losing the screen no longer means losing the account.
Vibez sign-up. Pick a package on the TV, finish on your phone, then sign in and carry on where you left off.

FIXES
Keyboard: Back closes it and keeps you on the same box; the keyboard's Next key moves to the next box.
Multi-Screen shows every picture again, and the content bar on the home screen is back.
Buffering? Long-press a channel and choose the step-by-step guide or send us a ticket.
A slimmer player bar that stays out of the picture.
Smoother and lighter: less running in the background while you watch.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.1 brings sign-up to the TV: create a DreamStreams account, take a free 2-day trial or buy a plan without leaving the app, and the Player signs itself in. Plex now signs in on its own when you are signed into Live TV. Adds My Account with renewals and gift codes, emails you your login after a trial or purchase, fixes the keyboard and Multi-Screen, and runs lighter in the background. Installs normally — no reinstall.
